items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: I got the band for her, and she -- and then, this was right at the beginning of the integration of the union, so the union gave her -- oh, let's see, what was it? I think it was a 42-piece band, and I was the conductor for it and everything.

ctx.x: Right, right, right, well, Mahalia Jackson, from her and all of these things stem. But they
-- it was a surge, almost all of the successful black rock and rollers come out of the church. You take Aretha Franklin, right out of the church.
